text:
Iris: quick flag  three interviewers reported they couldn't access the scorecard from the ATS link. link opens the interview but the "Give feedback" button is disabled.

Emma (People Ops): thanks Iris. can you grab one interview id and the recruiter who scheduled it?

Iris: int_7721, scheduled by noah.r. recruiter says the panelist sees the interview page but the feedback form is greyed out and shows 'template missing'.

Scheduler Bot: event=interview.created id=int_7721 status=200 payload={"template_ref":"onboard-rubric-v3", "access_flags": []}

Noah - Recruiting Ops: i pulled the audit: during a bulk tag sync last night the importer replaced some template_refs with an empty string when a null tag was present in CSV. i uploaded the CSV to #people-ops-attachments.

Priya - Eng: that sounds like the enrichment lambda trimming empty strings. i see a short stack: "ValueError: invalid template_ref ''" in enrichment-logger for run import-20240621. the worker returned 200 to the ATS front-end but left the database row with template_ref="" which disables the UI action.

Emma (People Ops): immediate mitigation: can recruiting set a conservative fallback template on affected interviews so panelists can submit feedback? which template is safest?

Noah - Recruiting Ops: fallback = "panel-standard-v1". we prefer not to resend candidate-facing emails. just need interviewer access to the form.

Priya - Eng: i can run a targeted backfill. please provide the list or i can run a query: ```sql
SELECT id, interview_id, interviewer_ids, created_at FROM interviews
WHERE template_ref = ''
AND created_at >= '2024-06-20' AND created_at < '2024-06-22';
``` i expect a small set.

Iris: ran that in reporting and got 3 rows: int_7721, int_7740, int_7799. uploading CSV now.

Priya - Eng: staging patch applied. sample int_7721 now shows template_ref=panel-standard-v1 and the "Give feedback" button enabled. smoke email sent to one reviewer.

Noah - Recruiting Ops: confirmed with recruiter: interviewer was able to submit feedback for int_7721. thanks.

Emma (People Ops): please run prod patch and capture job id. also let's add a quick note to Hiring Ops runbook about fallback template names and when to avoid re-emailing candidates.

Priya - Eng: prod job started job-42011 at 2024-06-21T16:05Z. patched 3 interviews. job logs: no other empty-template rows found.

Priya - Eng: opened ticket RECR-2001 to improve enrichment validation and return 4xx on bad template_ref instead of 200. also adding unit test to catch empty-string templates.

Noah - Recruiting Ops: follow-up ask from recruiters: could the ATS UI show a clearer tooltip when the button is disabled, like "missing scorecard template - contact recruiting"? saves a panic.

Emma (People Ops): good UX ask. i'll add to the recruiter FAQ and file REQ-432 for product.

Scheduler Bot: deploy enrichment-fix v1.1 -> prod succeeded (2024-06-21T16:34:20Z)

Iris: thanks team. closing loop — i'll watch for any more reports and ping if needed. :thumbsup:
